newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Etol to list its shares on February 21.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Etol to list its shares on February 21.

text.p: Slovenian oils and aroma maker Etol will list its shares on the main market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on February 21, the bourse said on Monday.
The company will list 192,627 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars ($74) each, representing 66.8 percent of its equity, the bourse said.
Etol will join a batch of 28 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main or the over-the-counter (OTC) markets of the Ljubljana bourse since the beginning of 1996.
Currently there are 25 shares traded on the main market, while another 30 are being traded on the OTC segment of the bourse. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
